rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Aldol needs an α-H: dilute NaOH → β-hydroxy carbonyl → heated → α,β-unsaturated aldehyde/ketone (dehydration); crossed aldol uses two different carbonyls.  ·  Trick 2: Cannizzaro needs NO α-H: conc. NaOH → alcohol + acid salt (disproportionation: one molecule oxidised, one reduced) — 2HCHO + NaOH → CH3OH + HCOONa.
